description: This Java source file defines the class FileSegmentManagedBuffer, which implements a ManagedBuffer backed by a segment of a file. It provides methods for reading file segments into ByteBuffers or InputStreams, converting to Netty objects for network transmission, and managing resource lifecycle.

classes.name: FileSegmentManagedBuffer
classes.description: A ManagedBuffer implementation that reads a specific segment of a file, supporting efficient IO operations and conversion for network transmission.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer segment.

methods.name: nioByteBuffer
methods.description: Reads the file segment into a ByteBuffer, using memory mapping if appropriate.

methods.name: createInputStream
methods.description: Creates an InputStream for the file segment, skipping to the specified offset.

methods.name: retain
methods.description: Retains the buffer (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the buffer (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: convertToNetty
methods.description: Converts the buffer to a Netty object for zero-copy transfer, using file descriptors if configured.

methods.name: convertToNettyForSsl
methods.description: Converts the buffer to a Netty ChunkedStream for SSL/TLS transfer.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset within the file.

methods.name: getLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the segment.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the buffer.
